HYPOTHESIS: if I fit Wu-trainable at n_outer=1 / lr=1e-2 / ep=6 on 200 stratified Mayo train slices, I expect a finite val_ssim that lands in/near the LD-FBP baseline band (~0.84-0.89 SSIM, hr near 0), because Wu-trainable is a tuned-FBP family (band-reweighting + ONE soft-thresholded residual pass, NO image-domain CNN denoiser) and can only recover the small headroom that band weighting + a single residual correction buys over plain FBP -- it is structurally close to FBP, unlike the dual-domain U-Net families that landed hr~0.27. The discarded boundary-slice run hinted ~0.9135 SSIM at run-best iter-11 (loose behavior hint, NOT a validated number under the corrected 214-slice 321px-FOV metric). This onboarding iter establishes the corrected-metric Wu-trainable baseline that iter-2+ will improve by tuning ONE knob (epochs/weight_decay first, then band/sigmoid knobs).
